To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

open source hardware is a complex phenomenon with a variety of interpretations, that the term open source hardware should be used with care as it is still not clearly defined, that the term is often misused and that the term open design is often used as a synonym for open source hardware.
1. The concept of open source is applied to a wide range of products.
the term “open source hardware”
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how to define open source hardware and what the implications of such a definition are.
the question of what open source means in the context of physical products, and how the concept can be applied in this context.
the question: what is the “Source of Open Source Hardware”?.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the source of open source hardware is not a simple thing. It is a combination of many things.
open source hardware is not a well-defined concept.
the source of open source hardware can be anything from schematics to a complete bill-of-materials.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
“open source” for hardware is not just a licence, but an approach to product development and dissemination.
the concept of open-source is a powerful one, but it is not a magic bullet.
the concept of open-source hardware is still in its infancy.
The main takeaway from our work is that

open source hardware is more than a licence, it is about a set of practices that are applied to a product’s lifecycle.

the term open source hardware is not a synonym of open source software.
there is no one size fits all approach to open source hardware and that the open source hardware label should be applied to a product only after careful examination of the product’s documentation.
